image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a bison standing in tall, dry grass. The bison's head and massive shoulder hump dominate the frame. The fur is dark brown and shaggy, particularly around the head and shoulders. Short, curved horns are visible. The background consists of blurred trees and a blue sky.

The eye is visible and appears dark, though partially shadowed by fur.
Ears are not prominently sticking out; they appear small and nestled within the thick fur of the head.
